clips.title: The story
paras: Gann Stonespire is an aggrieved tauren nomad found wandering the roads of the southern Barrens near Bael Modan. Driven from his tribe's ancestral hunting grounds by dwarven excavators, he seeks retaliation against the encroaching dig site.

Before the dwarven expedition arrived from Ironforge to carve out the fortress of Bael Modan, the surrounding land served as ancestral territory and hunting grounds for Gann Stonespire's tribe. The dwarven miners drove the indigenous tauren from their soil with pickaxes, firearms, and heavy machinery, refusing peaceful overtures. Now camping along the dusty southern Barrens road, Gann refuses to quietly surrender his heritage, marshaling travelers to strike back at the excavators.
